subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Education all the development efforts. An educated man can play a role in removing illiteracy. After all he/she is play a significant role to build up a nation. Illiteracy hampers a pre-condition for development. An uneducated man a burden of a nation.
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Education is a pre-condition for development. (b) An educated man can play a role in removing illiteracy. (c) After all he/she can play a significant role to build up a nation. (d) Illiteracy hampers all the development efforts. (e) An uneducated man is a burden of a nation.
